budget.historical_accounting: preserved; do not combine old estimates with new measured charges

rationale.repetitions: Five repeated executions describe within-input answer stability and latency spread. They do not add independent cases and are not a power calculation. No majority-vote replacement.
rationale.concurrency: One request in flight avoids local queue and cross-model load confounding in this small latency comparison.
rationale.timeout: 300-second total deadline; interrupted or timed-out requests remain operationally uncertain and are not replaced.
rationale.retries: Zero automatic retries or fallback: preserve first-attempt failure rates and prevent duplicate billing after ambiguous transport. Repetitions are planned independent executions, not failure replacements.
rationale.output_cap: 32768 tokens including reasoning and final JSON, inherited from the first two cohorts and supported by both selected endpoints.
rationale.versions: Named GLM 5.3 Flash and Kimi K3 routes, catalog snapshots 20260826 and 20260715, accepted returned model IDs recorded. This does not identify immutable weights.
rationale.tiers: Two user-selected additions: GLM-5.3-Flash and Kimi K3. The earlier eleven models are excluded from this run.
rationale.routing: OpenRouter uses existing credentials. GLM is restricted to Fireworks, whose catalog includes strict structured outputs. The Z.AI endpoint lists response_format but not structured_outputs. Kimi is restricted to Moonshot AI at moonshotai/mxfp4. No fallback or automatic retry.
rationale.effort: Both models support low/high/max in their first-party documentation. Request high explicitly through the router as the middle available effort, avoiding unsupported medium. This is not matched internal compute; actual upstream behavior remains observable only through saved responses and usage.
rationale.accounting: OpenRouter-reported response charges are primary. Catalog token-price estimates are separate; absent cache-write counts or rates remain unknown. No promotional route was selected. Reasoning tokens are included in completion totals once.

cohort.authorization: GLM-5.3-Flash and Kimi evaluated on the selected S2 development questions.
cohort.comparison: Same development evidence packets, question maps, references, derivation and scoring. Third execution cohort; latency comparisons across cohorts are descriptive.
